title: Manufacturing Engineering Technician I - First Shift - Bryan Dairy

cond_0001.intro:
Provide equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines.
Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum one to two years related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or training
Minimum one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree
Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

cond_0011.intro: Provide equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0011.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0011.requirements:
Associate's degree required; Bachelor's degree strongly preferred.
Minimum two years of demonstrated expertise in SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, and selective soldering.
Minimum two years of proven track record with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines.
Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

cond_0021.intro:
Provide equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines.
Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0021.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0021.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around one to two years of experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or related training, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Around one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience

cond_0149.intro: Provide equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines. Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with SMT processes and circuit assembly work.
cond_0149.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

cond_0181.intro:
Provide equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines.
Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0181.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0181.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum one to two years related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or training
Minimum one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree
Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

cond_0205.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team. This role provides equipment and process support, including machine maintenance, to printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0205.responsibilities:
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups.
Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate.
Observe machine and line performance and determine the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality.
Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data, and other available sources of information for tracking and gauging machine and process performance.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Determine when machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance.
Perform as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s) and execute repairs within skill level.
Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs.
Provide training and direction to Machine Operators on assigned line(s).
Assist with machine operation to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency.
Coordinate with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and ensure that assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees.
Support Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste.
Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements.
Provide daily pass-down reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

cond_0248.intro: Provide equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines. Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with SMT processes and circuit assembly work.
cond_0248.responsibilities: Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. cond_0258.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team, providing equipment and process support to printed circuit assembly lines. This role involves regular interaction with machine operators, line supervisors, and manufacturing engineers throughout the day. You should have hands-on knowledge of SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering, and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0258.responsibilities: Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and actively connect with them to provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Work closely with Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Stay in regular contact with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and serve as the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Work directly with Manufacturing Engineers to achieve optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum one to two years related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or training
Minimum one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Or equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree

cond_0278.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team. This role provides equipment and process support, including machine maintenance, to printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0278.responsibilities: Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality based on direct observation of machine and line performance. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data, and other available sources of information continuously to track and gauge machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when machine repairs are needed and execute out-of-cycle maintenance. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Direct Machine Operators on assigned line(s) through ongoing training and guidance. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and take ownership of ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality. Deliver training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Drive optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste in support of Manufacturing Engineers. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Deliver daily pass-down reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

Working closely with operators, engineers, and supervisors, you will help maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups. You will coordinate with the team to optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Together with line staff, you will monitor machine and line performance and help determine the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. You will share responsibility for continuously monitoring CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheets, feeder data, and other available sources to track and gauge machine and process performance.
You will help maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and work with the team to identify when out-of-cycle maintenance is needed. You will carry out as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). For non-SMT equipment, you will assist with initial diagnosis and execute repairs within your skill level, escalating more complex issues to Industrial Techs and supporting them as needed to accomplish repairs.
You will support Machine Operators on assigned line(s) through ongoing training and guidance, and assist with machine operation to help expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. You will coordinate with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions, serving as the front-line contact to help ensure assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
You will provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees and assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. You will share recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. You will provide daily pass-down reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
You will adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor, and comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0288.requirements:
Associate's degree highly preferred
Minimum one to two years related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or training
Minimum one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

cond_0299.responsibilities:

Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

cond_0366.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team, providing equipment and process support to printed circuit assembly lines. This role involves regular interaction with machine operators, line supervisors, and manufacturing engineers throughout the day. You should have hands-on knowledge of SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering, and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0366.responsibilities: Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and actively connect with them to provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Work closely with Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Stay in regular contact with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and serve as the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Work directly with Manufacturing Engineers to achieve optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

Coordinate with Manufacturing Engineers and Line Supervisors to maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups.
Work with the team to optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate.
Observe machine and line performance and share findings on the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality.
Help monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data, and other available sources of information continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Identify when out-of-cycle maintenance is needed and carry it out in coordination with the team.
Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s) and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs and assist as needed to accomplish repairs.
Support Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation to help expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency.
Work closely with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, helping ensure that assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees.
Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste.
Share recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements.
Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0387.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum one to two years of related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering, and/or training
Minimum one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Or equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree

cond_0522.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team, supporting equipment and process needs across printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0522.responsibilities:
Working closely with operators, engineers, and supervisors, you will help maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups. You will coordinate with the team to optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Together with line staff, you will monitor machine and line performance and help determine the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. You will share responsibility for continuously monitoring CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheets, feeder data, and other available sources to track and gauge machine and process performance.
You will help maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and work with the team to identify when out-of-cycle maintenance is needed. You will carry out as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). For non-SMT equipment, you will assist with initial diagnosis and execute repairs within your skill level, escalating more complex issues to Industrial Techs and supporting them as needed to accomplish repairs.
You will support Machine Operators on assigned line(s) through ongoing training and guidance, and assist with machine operation to help expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. You will coordinate with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions, serving as the front-line contact to help ensure assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
You will provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees and assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. You will share recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. You will provide daily pass-down reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
You will adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor, and comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0533.requirements:
Associate's degree required; Bachelor's degree strongly preferred.
Minimum two years of demonstrated expertise in SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, and selective soldering.
Minimum two years of proven track record with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines.
Or equivalent combination of education and experience.
cond_0533.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.

You will coordinate with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions, serving as the front-line contact to help ensure assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
You will provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees and assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. You will share recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. You will provide daily pass-down reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
You will adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor, and comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

cond_0558.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team, supporting equipment and process needs across printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0558.responsibilities:
Working closely with operators, engineers, and supervisors, you will help maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups. You will coordinate with the team to optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Together with line staff, you will monitor machine and line performance and help determine the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. You will share responsibility for continuously monitoring CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheets, feeder data, and other available sources to track and gauge machine and process performance.

For non-SMT equipment, you will assist with initial diagnosis and execute repairs within your skill level, escalating more complex issues to Industrial Techs and supporting them as needed to accomplish repairs.

You will coordinate with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions, serving as the front-line contact to help ensure assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
You will provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees and assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. You will share recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. You will provide daily pass-down reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
You will adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor, and comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

cond_0602.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team. This role provides equipment and process support, including machine maintenance, to printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0602.responsibilities: Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality based on direct observation of machine and line performance. Monitor CIQ, TARS, ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data, and other available sources of information continuously to track and gauge machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when machine repairs are needed and execute out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s) and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Direct Machine Operators on assigned line(s) through ongoing training and guidance. Lead machine operation to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and take ownership of ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality. Deliver training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Drive optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste in support of Manufacturing Engineers. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Deliver daily pass-down reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
